name: @builderforce/model-router
description: THE ordering of candidate models for one call: role objective (code -> strongest, explore -> cheapest, plan -> the tenant's order), learned evidence, vendor health, and expected cost from the workload profile and per-token prices. Reads the catalog through the CatalogView port, so the gateway, the editor, the on-prem runtime and an offline browser rank identically. Pure; dispatch and I/O stay with the host.
